title: Manufacturer’s installation instructions.
officialText: The application of SFRM shall be in accordance with the manu-facturer’s installation instructions. The instructions shall include, but are not limited to, substrate temperatures and surface conditions and SFRM handling, storage, mixing, conveyance, method of application, curing and ventilation.
